name: Nahor
title: Abraham's brother
summary: Nahor was the son of Terah and the brother of Abraham and Haran. He is an important figure in the patriarchal lineage, and his descendants played a significant role in Israel's history, notably as ancestors of Rebekah, Isaac's wife. Nahor settled in Mesopotamia, in the city that became known as the City of Nahor.

keyEvents.title: Nahor's Lineage Introduced
keyEvents.description: Nahor is mentioned as the son of Tarah, along with his brothers Abraham and Haran, in the genealogy of Genesis.

keyEvents.title: Nahor Marries Milcah
keyEvents.description: Nahor took Milcah, the daughter of his brother Haran, as his wife. Milcah became the mother of several of his sons.

keyEvents.title: Tarah's Family Leaves Ur
keyEvents.description: Tarah took his family from Ur of the Chaldeans, including Abraham and Lot. Nahor likely remained in Mesopotamia or settled in Haran.

keyEvents.title: Nahor's Twelve Sons
keyEvents.description: Abraham received word that Milcah had borne sons to Nahor, his brother. Eight sons were born to Milcah, and four to his concubine Reumah.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's Servant Sent to Nahor's City
keyEvents.description: Abraham sent his servant to Nahor's city in Aram-Naharaim to find a wife for Isaac from among Nahor's relatives. The servant found Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son.

keyEvents.title: Jacob flees to the descendants of Nahor
keyEvents.description: Jacob fled to Laban, son of Bethuel and grandson of Nahor, in Paddan-Aram. There he married Leah and Rachel, Laban's daughters.
